swing.description: 0 straight .. 0.5 heavy swing on off-beat steps

anyOf.description: Compact form: "<chord>:<beats>" tokens from bar 1 beat 1 in sequence, "r:<beats>" for no chord, e.g. "Dm9:4 | G13:4 | Em7:2 A7:2"

symbol.description: Chord symbol, e.g. Cm9, G13, F/A, Bb7#11

anyOf.description: Compact form: "<pitch>:<beats>[!]" tokens played in sequence, e.g. "5:.75! 4:.25 b3:1 r:.5 1+:1/3"

degree.description: 1-based scale degree of the mode; 8 = tonic an octave up

octave.description: Octave offset from the part's register centre

beat.description: Onset offset in beats from motif start (0-based)

low.description: Note name with octave, e.g. C4 (=MIDI 60), F#2, Bb5

high.description: Note name with octave, e.g. C4 (=MIDI 60), F#2, Bb5

grid.description: Steps per beat for step strings (4 = 16ths in 4/4, 3 = triplets)

rhythm.description: Step string; tokens depend on role (see spec)

transforms.description: e.g. transpose:+2, invert, retrograde, displace:+0.5, augment, diminish, octave:+1

repeatEvery.description: Motif repeat period in beats; 0 = once

steps.description: Step string: x hit, X accent, g ghost, . rest; | separates bars

groove.description: Drums: a named groove; lanes in `drums` only add voices it doesn't have

four_on_floor.description: house: kick on every beat, clap on 2 and 4, off-beat open hats, rolling 16th shaker

tech_house.description: tech house: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, off-beat pedal hat, ride on the beat, a pushed ghost snare

boom_bap.description: boom bap: syncopated kick, laid-back snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats (pair with swing around 0.15)

lofi.description: lofi: soft kick with an off-beat push, late snare and clap on 2 and 4, ghosted hats (pair with swing)

trap.description: trap (half-time at 130-170 BPM): sparse kicks, clap on 3, 8th hats with a 32nd roll before the bar line

drill.description: UK drill: half-time snare on 3 then on 4 in bar 2, sliding kicks off the downbeat, tresillo hats

dembow.description: reggaeton dembow: kick on every beat, snare on the 3-3-2 dembow accents (soft, then strong), light 8th hats

afrobeats.description: afrobeats: kick on 1, the and of 2, and 4; a rim on the skipping accents instead of a backbeat; accented 16th shaker

funk.description: funk (Funky Drummer): syncopated kick, backbeat snare with ghost notes, accented 16th hats opening on the e of 2 and 4

rock.description: rock: kick on 1 and 3 with pushes, snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats, crash on the first downbeat

pop.description: pop: kick on 1 and the and of 2 and 3, clap and tambourine on 2 and 4, 8th hats

ballad.description: ballad: soft kick on 1 and 3, cross-stick on 2 and 4, gentle 8th hats

neo_soul.description: neo-soul: behind-the-beat pocket, late snare and hats, ghosted 16ths

dnb.description: drum and bass: two-step kick and snare with ghost snares, ride 8ths, off-beat hats

half_time.description: half-time: kick on 1, snare on 3, 8th hats; slow hip hop and builds

cinematic_toms.description: cinematic: big low-tom ostinato over kick on 1 and 3, crash on the first downbeat

sparse_pulse.description: ambient: a soft pulse; kick on 1, ride quarter notes, light shaker

jazz_swing.description: jazz swing (triplet grid): spang-a-lang ride, hi-hat foot on 2 and 4, feathered kick, cross-stick on 4

brush_swing.description: brushes (triplet grid): swirling brush snare, feathered kick, hi-hat foot on 2 and 4

jazz_waltz.description: jazz waltz (triplet grid): skipping ride, hi-hat foot on 2 and 3, feathered kick

waltz.description: waltz: kick on 1, cross-stick on 2 and 3, 8th hats

six_eight.description: 6/8: kick on 1, snare on 4, every eighth on the hats with accents on 1 and 4; ballads and folk

gospel_shuffle.description: gospel 6/8: kick on 1 with a pickup on 6, snare on 4 with a ghost, accented hats

pitch.description: Note name with octave, e.g. C4 (=MIDI 60), F#2, Bb5

message.description: Human-readable; never contains keys or other secrets

provider.description: pi-ai provider id, e.g. anthropic, openai, openrouter, google

ContextOverride.description: null = follow the host (tempo, meter), the score (swing) or the default (key, bars)

partIds.description: Parts this node changed; null = all

entryId.description: The library clip this node started from (lib:<pack>/<clip>); its credit travels with the node

text.description: Prompt, or the assistant's reply / answer to a production question

nodeId.description: The lineage node this item produced; its result card

locked.description: Kept as-is by generate, vary and edit

density.description: Density knob; 0.5 = as written. A local transform, not a lineage node

role.description: Only send this role's part from this instance; null = all parts

channel.description: Send everything on this channel; null = each part's own channel

nodeId.description: Node to play; null = the current node

loop.description: Bars to loop; null = the whole clip

freeRun.description: Play on the plugin's own clock while the host is stopped

sublane.description: v1 sublane: kick, snare, clap_rim, hats, toms, cymbals, aux_kit

voices.description: Drums only: GM map for sublane rows and split export

Clip.description: core's realization of a node, for lanes and piano rolls

Usage.description: From the service, never estimated locally

byokEnabled.description: Release flag; read-only for the UI

hasKey.description: A BYOK key is stored for `provider`; the key itself never crosses the bridge back

reason.description: Why it can't run in this build, for the UI to show

text.description: Attribution, shown wherever the clip is: card, preview, drag and export

allowsStyleExamples.description: The planner may show the clip to a model as a style example

id.description: lib:<pack>/<clip> for library clips, node:<nodeId> for AI results

roles.description: The parts in the clip; a library clip has one

genres.description: Style tags in the planner's vocabulary (lowercase kebab-case)

tonic.description: null = not known reliably; keyNote says why

keyNote.description: How the key was found, or why it is blank

energy.description: 0..1 from core's analysis; null for AI results until analyzed

rhythm.description: Onset F1 between the IR's realization and the original MIDI

pitch.description: Mean pitch-class overlap of matched onsets

notes.description: Note F1 (exact pitch; pitch class for chords)

literalNotes.description: Original notes the IR keeps as literal notes

file.description: Normalized SMF next to the catalog: flat file name, no directories

sha256.description: Of the pack's source file, so a changed source shows up as drift

harmony.description: Chord symbols in order, as the analyzer named them

notes.description: Lane notes and omissions, e.g. why a pack has no drums

text.description: Words matched against title, genres, tags, feel, producer and prompt; empty = any

roles.description: null = any; an entry matches if it has one of these parts

fitContext.description: Rank by fit to the session's key, tempo and meter, and leave out other meters

captureBars.description: Bars of recently played MIDI available to `generate.capture`

preview.description: Catalog entry being previewed in time with the host; null = none

unavailable.description: What this build answers `unavailable` (or ignores), so the UI can disable it and say why

redo.description: Node ids undone from currentNodeId, most recent last

SavedSession.description: Plugin state (getStateInformation). No keys, no provider credentials.

count.description: Variations to plan in parallel; each becomes a node

amount.description: register: octaves; transpose: semitones; humanize: 0..1; others: null

remove.description: Notes as they appear in the current clip

key.description: null = delete. Goes straight to the OS keychain; never logged or saved

nodeId.description: null = the current node (a thread card can drag its own node)

entryId.description: A library clip becomes a new `library` node; an AI result is selected
Drags the clip as written: a library clip's MIDI, or an AI result's node

requestId.description: Set when the command started a model request

session.description: Set on hello and on any command that changed the session

nodeIds.description: One per variation; empty when the reply was text only

keep.description: Locked parts (and harmony) to plan around; null = fresh plan

partIds.description: Parts the edit may change; locked parts are excluded

text.description: For the thread: a short note on the result, or the answer to a question

score.description: null when the request was answered with text only
